newsitem.title: UK: Moody's affirms N Electric, rates CE Electric.
newsitem.headline: Moody's affirms N Electric, rates CE Electric.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Friday it confirmed Northern Electric Plc's senior long-term debt rating of A3 and its commercial paper rating of Prime 2.
The agency also said in a statement it assigned a new bank debt rating of Baa1 to CE Electric UK Holdings,.

"The rating action concludes a review initiated on October 28, 1996, following the announcement of a bid for the company (Northern Electric) by CalEnergy Company, Inc and Peter Kiewit Sons' Inc," Moody's said.
Long term debt ratings of A3 are confirmed for Northern Electric's sterling bonds due 1999, 2005 and 2020, the agency said.
